title: things you only notice once you're back at work

text: things you only notice once you're back at work after maternity leave
you refresh the nursery app more than your emails
one photo of him eating lunch and your whole afternoon is made
a hot coffee, drunk while it's still hot
i'd forgotten that was an option
the office toilet is the quietest room you've been in for a year
i'm not saying i hide there. i'm not saying i don't
nursery bugs arrive in week two
the commute is the only time nobody needs anything from you
i read. i stare out of the window. it's bliss
you're tired in a completely new way
what did you only notice once you went back?
tell me i'm not the only one
